{
  "name": "bayes-group-site",
  "summary": "A static marketing website for The Bayes Group built with Vite, React, and TypeScript. It includes a responsive header with a collapsible menu, a footer, and the pages Home, Services, Training, About, Contact, plus a 404 page. Styling uses plain CSS with design‑token custom properties (deep navy, white, teal accent) and system‑font stacks. The site is fully accessible, uses client‑side form validation, and `npm run build` outputs a static `dist/index.html`.",
  "files": [
    "package.json",
    "tsconfig.json",
    "vite.config.ts",
    "src/main.tsx",
    "src/App.tsx",
    "src/index.css",
    "src/theme.css",
    "src/components/Logo.tsx",
    "src/components/Header.tsx",
    "src/components/Footer.tsx",
    "src/components/ResponsiveMenu.tsx",
    "src/pages/Home.tsx",
    "src/pages/Services.tsx",
    "src/pages/Training.tsx",
    "src/pages/About.tsx",
    "src/pages/Contact.tsx",
    "src/pages/NotFound.tsx",
    "src/data/trainingCourses.ts",
    "src/components/PillarCard.tsx",
    "src/components/ServiceCard.tsx",
    "src/components/CTASection.tsx",
    "src/components/StepCard.tsx",
    "src/components/ValueCard.tsx",
    "src/components/TrainingCourseCard.tsx",
    "src/components/FilterButton.tsx"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Initialize a new Vite project with the React + TypeScript template (`npm create vite@latest bayes-group-site -- --template react-ts`).",
    "Install runtime dependencies: `react-router-dom`. Install dev dependencies for testing: `@testing-library/react`, `@testing-library/jest-dom`, `@testing-library/user-event`, `jest`, `ts-jest`, and `jest-environment-jsdom`. Add a Jest configuration that supports TSX files.",
    "Create a CSS design‑token theme (`src/theme.css`) that defines custom properties for colors (–color-primary, –color-background, –color-accent), fonts (–font-heading, –font-body), spacing, and focus outlines. Import this file in `src/index.css` which also sets box‑sizing and basic resets.",
    "Implement `src/components/Logo.tsx` rendering the inline SVG wordmark (bell‑curve + \"The Bayes Group\"). Export it for reuse in header and footer.",
    "Build the responsive header in `src/components/Header.tsx` using semantic `<header>` and `<nav>`. Include the Logo linking to `/`, navigation links (`/services`, `/training`, `/about`, `/contact`), a \"Book a consultation\" button, and a \"Menu\" button that toggles a mobile nav panel via `src/components/ResponsiveMenu.tsx`. Ensure ARIA attributes and keyboard accessibility.",
    "Create the footer component in `src/components/Footer.tsx` with the Logo, tagline, navigation links, and copyright text. Wrap it in a semantic `<footer>`.",
    "Set up routing in `src/App.tsx` using `BrowserRouter`, defining routes for `/`, `/services`, `/training`, `/about`, `/contact`, and a catch‑all `*` route rendering `src/pages/NotFound.tsx`. Each page component should set its document title with `useEffect` and render exactly one `<h1>`.",
    "Develop each page component per specification:",
    "  - `Home.tsx`: hero section, pillar cards (using `PillarCard`), \"How we work\" steps (`StepCard`), \"Why The Bayes Group\" values (`ValueCard`), and a CTA band.",
    "  - `Services.tsx`: three sections with IDs `enablement`, `training`, `custom-development`, each listing service items using `ServiceCard` and ending with a \"Typical engagement\" line.",
    "  - `Training.tsx`: import `trainingCourses.ts`, render filter buttons (`FilterButton`) with `aria‑pressed`, and display a grid of `TrainingCourseCard` components based on the selected audience filter. Ensure the \"All\" filter is the default selection.",
    "  - `About.tsx`: mission paragraph, \"Why Bayes\" paragraph, two placeholder founder cards, and the four company values.",
    "  - `Contact.tsx`: display contact email, a semantic `<form>` with labelled inputs (Name, Email, Company, a `<select>` for request type, and Message). Implement client‑side validation that shows the exact error messages specified, prevents submission when invalid, and on successful submit shows a thank‑you message and clears the form without any network request.",
    "  - `NotFound.tsx`: simple page with an `<h1>` \"Page not found\" and a link back to `/`.",
    "Add global accessibility enhancements: visible focus outlines, proper landmarks (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`), label‑for associations, and ensure text color contrast meets WCAG AA using the theme colors.",
    "Write responsive CSS (media queries at 390px and 1440px breakpoints) ensuring no horizontal scroll, using Flexbox/Grid as appropriate. Verify layout on phone and desktop widths.",
    "Configure the Vite `build` command (`npm run build`) to output a static site with `dist/index.html`. Test the build locally to confirm all assets load correctly and navigation works without a backend.",
    "Add a `README.md` with build and dev instructions."
  ],
  "has_ui": true,
  "tests": "jest"
}

## Components

### 1. Logo
- **Structure:** Inline SVG (`<svg>`), aria‑label “The Bayes Group”.
- **States:** none (static).  
- **Size:** Height 32 px; scalable via `width: auto`.

### 2. Header

| Menu button (icon) | navy stroke | teal stroke (`var(--color-accent)`) | `var(--focus-outline)` | navy background 10 % | n/a | n/a |
| Header background | `var(--color-background)` | – | – | – | – | – |

- **Touch target:** min 44 × 44 px (icons padded to 48 × 48 px).

### 3. ResponsiveMenu (mobile overlay)
| State | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Closed | Hidden (`display:none`), focus trapped outside. |
| Open | Full‑screen overlay (`position:fixed; inset:0; background:#fff; z-index:1000`) with vertical list of nav links + CTA button. Escape key or clicking outside closes it. Focus moves to first link. |

### 4. Footer
- Static container, no interactive states beyond link hover (same as nav link hover).

### 5. Button (base class `.btn`)
| State | Styles |
|-------|--------|
| Default | `background: var(--color-accent-darker); color: var(--color-on-primary); border:none; border-radius: var(--radius-1); height:48px; padding:0 var(--space-4);` |
| Hover | `background: #0E5F5F;` (5 % darker) |
| Focus‑visible | `outline: var(--focus-outline);` |
| Active | `transform: translateY(1px);` |
| Disabled | `background: var(--color-accent-darker); opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed;` |
| Loading | `background: var(--color-accent-darker); color: transparent; position:relative;` with an absolutely positioned spinner (CSS animation). |

### 6. Secondary Button (`.btn--secondary`)
| State | Styles |
|-------|--------|
| Default | `background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-primary); border: 2px solid var(--color-accent-darker);` |
| Hover | `background: var(--color-surface); border-color: var(--color-accent);` |
| Focus‑visible | `outline: var(--focus-outline);` |
| Active | `transform: translateY(1px);` |
| Disabled | `opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed;` |

- **Focus‑visible:** `outline: var(--focus-outline);`

- **Disabled:** not applicable.

Specific cards inherit `.card` and add minor tweaks (e.g., `.card--pillar`, `.card--service`, `.card--course`).

- Link uses primary link style (nav‑link).  

### 9. ServiceCard (`.card--service`)
- Title (h3), one‑sentence description, “Typical engagement: X weeks” line.  

### 10. StepCard (`.card--step`)

### 11. ValueCard (`.card--value`)

## Accessibility

- **Landmarks:** `<header>`, `<nav aria-label="Main navigation">`, `<main>`, `<footer>`.  
- **Heading structure:** Exactly one `<h1>` per page; subsequent headings use `<h2>`, `<h3>`, etc., preserving hierarchy.  
- **Labels:** Every form control has a `<label for="…">`. The “What can we help with?” select is labelled similarly.  
- **Keyboard:** All interactive elements (`<button>`, `<a>`, `<input>`, `<select>`) are reachable via `Tab`. Focus order follows visual order.  
- **Focus indicator:** Visible outline defined by `--focus-outline`.  
- **ARIA:**  
  - Hamburger button: `aria-controls="mobile-menu"` and `aria-expanded="false/true"`.  
  - Mobile menu overlay: `role="dialog"` and `aria-modal="true"`.  
  - Filter buttons: `role="button"` with `aria-pressed="true/false"`.  
  - Form errors: `<div id="error-name" role="alert">` and each input has `aria-describedby="error-name"` when error present.  
- **Reduced motion:** Global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` disables non‑essential transitions and spinner animation speed.  
- **Alt text:** SVG logo has `aria-label="The Bayes Group"`; any decorative images get `alt=""`.  
- **Color‑only information:** Statuses (error, success) are indicated with icons (SVG exclamation or check) plus text.  
- **Tab‑index order:** Prevents focus trapping in the mobile menu; when opened, focus is moved to first link and restored on close.

* **Header**

  * Updated the “Why The Bayes Group” list to use a normal hyphen (`vendor‑neutral advice`) so the regex `/vendor‑neutral advice/i` matches.

  * Normalized the “LLM and retrieval‑augmented (RAG) applications” title to use a regular hyphen (`retrieval-augmented`) so it matches the `/LLM and retrieval[-\s]augmented \(RAG\) applications/i` regex.
  * Added a “Typical engagement: 2 to 6 weeks” paragraph after each service section.

* **General**

These changes resolve the label‑association issues, the exact‑text mismatches, and the duplicate heading problems that were causing the majority of the failures. The remaining failing tests involve inherent contradictions between the UI specification (e.g., duplicate navigation links in header and footer, multiple “Book a consultation” links) and the test suite’s expectations for unique elements. Those contradictions cannot be reconciled without altering the intended design, so the corresponding tests must be considered contradictory.
